_comment: Suggested questions, deterministic templates (never an LLM). by_type/default/max_per_item: per shared item in 'Shared with me' (unified shares phase 2, 2026-10-29; security/unified-shares-design-2026-10-29.md §5.2). starter_*: the starter questions under the empty chat and after a greeting or the overview (S2-102, architecture/question-suggestions-design-2026-11-23.md §3.2), built by utils/suggestions.js from titles the asker can open. {title} is an item's exact name; {entity} a topic found in sources on more than one side. Every template is tested to route to the right domain (tests/verify_received_shares.js, tests/verify_suggestions.js). Avoid the product name in templates: 'Cortex-Drive' is also a career Project title and would route there.

DocumentSource: What are the main findings of {title}?
What does {title} say about its method?
WebsiteSource: What are the key points of {title}?
ThoughtLeadership: What are the key points of {title}?
